text: Implemented QueryOracle source generator and independent set-algebra evaluator, with explicit lexical/numeric ages and cross-subject/session adversarial witnesses. Three deterministic seeds checked; 37 queries cover correlation, missing/type-specific metadata, decimal boundaries and lexical IDs. target/night-query-oracle-tests.log passes pure oracle and reference lifecycle with two generated datasets, corrected/historical releases, stable paging and whole-universe revocation.
